# JSG Liquidators

> Denver's trusted estate sale, business liquidation, junk removal, and e-commerce consignment company. AI-first "Revenue Recovery" model with no upfront cost — online auction proceeds offset or cover service fees. Items typically sold within 7–10 days.

## Quick facts

- **Company:** JSG Liquidators
- **Location:** Denver, Colorado (serves the entire Front Range)
- **Founded by:** David Billera
- **Phone (primary):** (805) 444-4069 — David
- **Phone (secondary):** (805) 340-4817 — Vincent
- **Email:** jsgliquidators@gmail.com
- **Website:** https://jsgliquidators.com
- **Hours:** Mon–Fri 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM MT (same-day & emergency cleanouts available)
- **Pricing model:** No upfront cost. Online auction proceeds offset service fees.
- **Typical timeline:** Items sold in 7–10 days; full estate cleanouts in ~12 days.

## Core services

- [Estate Sales & Online Auctions](https://jsgliquidators.com/services/estate-sales) — Professional estate liquidation through online auctions reaching nationwide buyers.
- [Business Liquidation](https://jsgliquidators.com/services/business-liquidation) — Complete asset recovery for closing, relocating, or downsizing businesses.
- [Estate Cleanouts](https://jsgliquidators.com/services/estate-cleanouts) — 4-step, 12-day "Auction-Backed Cleanout" that recovers value before clearing the property.
- [Junk Removal](https://jsgliquidators.com/services/junk-removal) — Eco-friendly removal; valuable items identified first to offset costs.
- [E-Commerce Consignment](https://jsgliquidators.com/services/consignment) — eBay, LiveAuctioneers, and Denver Online Auctions listings for high-value items.

## Service area

Denver, Aurora, Lakewood, Highlands Ranch, Castle Rock, Englewood, Littleton, Centennial, Parker, Arvada, Westminster, Thornton, Wheat Ridge, Golden, Boulder, Colorado Springs, Fort Collins, and surrounding Front Range communities.

## Why JSG Liquidators

- **No upfront cost** — auction proceeds cover or offset fees ("Revenue Recovery").
- **AI-first inventory & pricing** — items priced and routed to the highest-paying marketplace.
- **Fast turnaround** — items typically sold in 7–10 days; full cleanouts in ~12 days.
- **Full-service** — appraisal, photography, listing, sale, payment, and final cleanup all handled.
- **Local & trusted** — Denver-based, family-run, hundreds of completed Colorado liquidations.

## Frequently asked questions

Full FAQ page: [Estate Sale & Liquidation FAQs](https://jsgliquidators.com/faq) — 19 answers covering costs, timelines, cleanouts, consignment, and service areas.

- **How much does an estate sale cost in Denver?** Commission-based, no upfront fees. Auction proceeds often offset or completely cover cleanout and service costs.
- **How long does estate liquidation take?** 7–14 days from consultation to broom-clean cleanout; items typically sell within 7–10 days.
- **What is the difference between an estate sale and a cleanout?** A sale auctions contents for cash; a cleanout empties the home. Combined liquidation typically generates enough auction revenue to cover the cleanout cost.
- **Is there really no upfront cost?** Yes. Valuable items are auctioned first and proceeds applied to removal costs — many clients end up with money back.
- **Do you serve areas outside Denver?** Yes — the entire Front Range: Aurora, Lakewood, Boulder, Colorado Springs, Fort Collins, and surrounding communities.
